# Software as a Service Agreement

This Agreement is dated 2 February 2026 and is made between Quillfeather Software Ltd (the "Provider") and Bramblewood Dental Group Ltd (the "Customer").

## 1. Definitions
1.1 "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in England.
1.2 "Platform" means the Provider's hosted practice management software.

## 2. Services
2.1 The Provider shall make the Platform available to the Customer from the Effective Date.
2.2 The Provider shall use reasonable endeavours to notify the Customer of scheduled maintenance at least 48 hours in advance.

## 3. Fees
3.1 The Customer shall pay each invoice within 30 days of the date of invoice.
3.2 The Provider may increase the Fees once in each Contract Year by giving not less than 60 days' written notice.

## 4. Governing Law
4.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

6.2 The Processor shall forward to the Controller any Data Subject request it receives within 5 Business Days of receipt.
6.3 The Processor shall not respond directly to a Data Subject request except on the documented instructions of the Controller.
6.4 The Processor may charge the Controller at its standard rates for assistance under this clause 6 that exceeds 10 hours in any calendar month.

## 7. Records
7.1 The Processor shall maintain a record of all categories of processing activities carried out on behalf of the Controller.

# Schedule 1 - Definitions and Interpretation

This Schedule forms part of the Staffing Services Agreement between Wexcombe Clinical Staffing Ltd (the "Supplier") and Haddon Vale Hospice (the "Customer").

## 1. Definitions
1.1 "Assignment" means a period during which a Worker is supplied to the Customer.
1.2 "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or bank holiday in England.
1.3 "Worker" means an individual supplied by the Supplier to provide clinical services.

## 2. Interpretation
2.1 Words in the singular shall include the plural and vice versa.
2.2 Clause headings shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
2.3 A reference to a statute is a reference to it as amended from time to time.

# Scaffold Hire Agreement

This Agreement is made between Hartwell Scaffolding Ltd (the "Supplier") and Greyfriars Developments Ltd (the "Customer").

## 2. Hire
2.1 The Supplier shall erect the Scaffold within 5 Working Days of the Customer's order.
2.2 The Supplier shall inspect the Scaffold at intervals not exceeding 7 days and after any adverse weather.
2.3 The Customer shall not alter or remove any part of the Scaffold.

## 3. Hire Charges
3.1 The minimum hire period is 4 weeks.
3.2 The Customer shall pay hire charges every 4 weeks in advance.
3.3 If the Customer fails to pay any sum when due, the Supplier shall be entitled to strike the Scaffold on 7 days' notice.

documents.text:
# Parcel Delivery Services Agreement

This Agreement is made between Brisk Parcel Network Ltd (the "Courier") and Moss & Fern Home Ltd (the "Retailer").

## 3. Performance
3.1 The Courier undertakes to deliver at least 97% of Parcels on the Committed Delivery Day in each calendar month.
3.2 The Courier shall attempt delivery of each Parcel on at least two occasions before returning it to the Retailer.
3.3 The Courier shall not leave Parcels with neighbours unless the recipient has authorised it.

## 4. Retailer Obligations
4.1 The Retailer shall upload manifest data for each day's Parcels by 18:00 on the day before collection.

## 5. Claims
5.1 The Courier will compensate the Retailer for lost Parcels up to a maximum of £250 per Parcel.
